content: कणः .²1 A grain, a single seed; तण्डुलकणान् <ls>H. 1</ls>; कणान् वा भक्षयेदब्दम् <ls>Ms. 11. 93</ls>. .²2 An atom or particle (of anything). .²3 A very small quantity; द्रविण˚ <ls>Śānti. 1. 19</ls>, <ls n="Śānti.">3. 5</ls>. .²4 A grain of dust. रजःकणैः खुरोद्धूतैः <ls>R. 1. 85</ls>; or of pollen; ईषद्बद्धरजःकणाग्रकपिशा <ls>V. 2. 7</ls>. .²5 A drop (of water) or spray; कणवाही मालिनीतरङ्गाणाम् <ls>Ś. 3. 7</ls>; अम्बु˚, अश्रु˚; उद्यानानां नवजलकणैर्यूथिकाजालकानि <ls>Me. 26</ls>, <ls n="Me.">47</ls>, <ls n="Me.">71</ls>; <ls>Amaru. 54</ls>. .²6 An ear of corn. .²7 Spark (as of fire). .²8 The spark or facet of a gem. .²9 Flake (of snow). .²10 श्वेतजीरक; <ab>cf.</ab> ‘कणोऽतिसूक्ष्मे धान्यांशे पिप्पल्यां जीरके शरे’ <ls>Nm.</ls> .{@-णा@} .²1 A kind of fly. .²2 Long pepper. .²3 Cumin seed. .{@-णी@} .²1 An atom, a drop. .²2 A kind of corn. .²3 The plant Premna Spinosa or Longifolia. .²4 A crocodile; <ls>Gīrvāṇa.</ls>
